inputSources.preparation: scripts/prepare-beat-benchmark.py; 22050Hz mono f32le; original reference JSON preserved

protocol.referenceBoundary: finite numeric reference times with 0 <= time <= pcmFloat32Frames / sampleRate; inclusive; raw inputs remain unchanged
protocol.matcher: distinct nearest; 70ms and 50ms; no leading-time trim; predicted events are not clipped

bootstrap.limitation: Descriptive uncertainty for this fixed, small systematic subset; not proof of song/artist/population independence or musical quality.

gate.averaging: macro across exactly 30 clips; absolute metric deltas
gate.fourFingerRetentionDefinition: deduplicated note heads within own measured candidates +/-20ms; after count / V7 count per clip; V7 zero requires a nonempty valid after chart

protocol.interpretation: Single-finger head F1 measures primary-beat selection compatibility only. Four-finger measured-onset head counts, V7 onset identities retained, source-path changes, density and validity are separate. Higher F1 is not a full musical-quality claim; never alter this gate after seeing final results.
protocol.candidateRule: Preserve V7 global Viterbi; guard only actual handoffs with supported period and phase memory; isolate boundary before regular peak dedup and inference, restore selected opening source only, never anchor/snap or classify boundary; classify existing selected DSP attacks with at least three measured beat bindings; manual BPM is explicit and reversible; retain deterministic finger planning and all four modes.
protocol.validationBeforeFreeze: 397 source tests passed, 1 private-song test skipped; TypeScript and Vite production build passed; final unseen data has not been analyzed.
